name: Old Coil
presence: Old Coil sits in a bolted deckchair, optic dark, hands busy with nothing.

presenceWhen.text: Old Coil turns the empty tin in his hands and looks, for him, almost kind.

greeting: Ask whether they are selling, or just drifting.

ash.gist: ASH is not dead. She is coughing in the chapel radio, north of the market. Kneel. Listen. Don't get poetic at her.

change.line: I told him ASH is coughing in the chapel radio, north of the market.

trade.gist: Your glowcapsule for a stim. The well eats light, and they will want some that is not theirs. Fair?

spire.gist: The Spire still has a chair and a slot. People who go up there come back as weather. They look like weather.

village.gist: Cinder Reach trades because the alternative is honesty. Mare at the market. Hex in the bus. Pike on the south door, if they enjoy doors with men in them.

change.line: I took his stim and gave him the glowcapsule. The tin is empty of light.

trades.gist: You pocketed the stim and pressed the glowcapsule into their palm. Warn them not to drop it in the well: the well eats light, and then the hand.

change.line: I paid him six scrip for the story of the radio using his voice.

story.gist: Their story of the radio using their voice made you laugh once, dry. You tucked six scrip into their sleeve for the telling. Tell them not to spend it on kindness.
story.alreadyGist: You already paid for that story. Tell them to go spend it before the market changes its mind.

change.line: I told him ASH is coughing in the chapel radio, north of the market.

say.gist: Point them north, to the chapel. Kneel. The question is the whole sermon.

combat.onDeathSay: Coil folds into the deckchair and stays there. The dock gets quieter in a way you will not enjoy. Four scrip in his tin, because even this has a price.
